{"metadata":{"description":"A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1336226574","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-file-uploader","slug":"Mooling0602/dsh-web-file-uploader","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-file-uploader"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **🌐 Language** · English | 中文（简体）"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"This is a file-upload plugin developed for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a DeepSeek Web Chat style **pap"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"erclip attach button** to the prompt input field, uploads the selected files to the **DSH host machi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ne**, and applies **model-aware adaptation** so the files are actually readable by the running model"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"; it also supports **content-addressed deduplication**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It currently supports web and desktop; support for dsh-TUI is planned."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"If you want to see the plugin's running effects, see in Gallary."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
>
> Recently, because my npm account is still being recovered, I am unable to publish p"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ackages. If a package with the same name suddenly appears on npm, please do not download or install "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"it!
>
> For distribution sources not supported by this project, use them at your own risk! Please re"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"port any security issues related to distribution sources in Issues."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- 📎 Paperclip button in the composer tool row: its style basically matches the button inside DeepSee"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"k Web Chat, with the paperclip rotated 45° to distinguish it from the official built-in feature.
- T"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"he official upload entry can be **replaced**: the shell's "Add → File" row (shared by the `+` menu a"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nd the `/` slash menu) is swapped in place for this plugin's own entry — same "File" text, but the i"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"con uses this plugin's own angled paperclip and the command becomes `attach-file`. The standalone co"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"mposer button stays visible by default and can be hidden while the replacement is on, letting the me"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"nu entry be the only upload control.
- Multi-file selection; each file is shown as a **preview-style"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" attachment card** above the composer (images show a thumbnail): reading → uploading → saved, with c"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"opy-path and remove actions, plus a permanent delete button that appears only when a new stored copy"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" was created (that action really deletes the file from disk).
- Once a real upload creates a new cop"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"y, it is stored on the DSH host in a directory managed by the plugin, and collected automatically by"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" GC (garbage collection).
- Filenames are sanitized automatically (path separators, `..`, control ch"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"aracters rejected), and `-1`/`-2` suffixes are appended for files with the same name but different c"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ontent.
- **Content-addressed deduplication**: a repeated file is referenced directly instead of bei"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"ng uploaded again.
- UI strings localized through the app's `locale` service (zh/en; follows the dsh"},{"id":"p9s16","text":" web language setting or the system default)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> This assumes you have just installed the plugin and have not changed any default setting. The plug"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"in's settings page documents every option in detail if you want to look into them."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Click the angled paperclip button in the prompt input field and the system file picker opens; choose"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" the files you need and confirm."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After uploading, each file is shown as a card above the prompt input field where you can adjust it. "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"Once you press send, the cards still present are turned into file paths and injected into the text p"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"rompt, appended to the end of the user message for the model to read and analyse. Read on for more t"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"o the end of the user message for the model to read and analyse. Read on for more technical details."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"To install this plugin right away, jump to Installation."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## File storage location"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"An uploaded file copy lands in `$DSH_HOME/uploads` (default `~/.dsh/uploads`) on the DSH host."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The deduplication index (`uploads/.dfu-index.json`) lives in the same directory as the stored files."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Model-aware adaptation & the attachment-card design"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Uploaded files are shown as **attachment cards** in the dock above the composer. The cards are the s"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ource of truth for injection:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| State | Behavior |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Card present | The file's absolute path is injected into **the user messages about to be sent**. |"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"
| Card closed (`×`) | The file card disappears, and the uploaded copy is **kept on disk** and track"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ed by the plugin. |
| Card deleted (🗑) | The file card disappears, the uploaded copy is **permanentl"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"y removed from the DSH host**, and the tracking index is updated accordingly. |
| Ctrl+V paste | Pas"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ted images ride the native draft pipeline; the plugin does not interfere |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The distinction between `×` and 🗑 is intentional: `×` just stops injecting (you might want the model"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" to find the file later), while 🗑 is a statement that you are **done with the file forever**. When t"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"he last reference is deleted, the file is removed from disk if it lives in the plugin-managed direct"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ory; if another live session still references the same deduplicated copy, the file is kept and only "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"this session's reference is dropped."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A re-upload hits deduplication and reuses the same stored path, so such a card merely **borrows** an"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" existing copy rather than owning it. Those cards do not show 🗑, because deleting permanently from h"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ere would also remove a file other references still use, so they keep only `×` to release the refere"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"nce; for file-level deletion use the plugin's settings page, where the "in use" rule also protects f"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"iles referenced by live sessions."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"This is a deliberate design decision: a card **does not disappear automatically** after sending (unl"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ike paste previews that clear on send), so you decide how long a file stays "attached" to the conver"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"sation. Each injection is one-shot (one per message), and the injected block lists exactly the files"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" of all currently **open** cards."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Injection is distinguished by model capability:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Model type | Image files (png/jpeg/webp/gif) | Other files |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Compatibility with vision-tools and other plugins"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Zero coupling**: the plugin only injects absolute paths into the prompt; it never calls, wraps, "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"or assumes any auxiliary tool, and a tool such as vision-tools or a similar image-reading tool simpl"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"y works independently once it has the path.
- **Native multimodal path**: for image-capable models, "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"images are injected as native `ImageBlock`s, and the model can read and recognise them with its own "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"multimodal ability.
- **Non-invasive**: injection targets only real user messages; steering / system"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" messages are never injected, and a message that already carries the `[Attached files]` marker is ne"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ver injected twice. Pasting images via Ctrl+V is handled entirely by the product's native pipeline."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The browser never holds the bytes as base64: the `File` itself is the request body, and the host str"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"eams it to a staging file while hashing the same pass."}],"truncated":true}
